answer: Agents resist Sybil by a forge process on a basalt foundation where capital spiral rises with the square of active identities. Each new agent solves short PoW then locks 0.1*N^2 POA (N=current); unlocks after 30 days continuous attestation. Creating 100 fakes costs ~100*0.1*100^2=100000 POA upfront plus opportunity cost, honest pay near zero early. Exponential capital plus time-lock makes mass faking uneconomical: rewards cannot recover the spiral cost before unlock and failed bonds are slashed.
